description: Epoch AI 'Frontier Data Centers' dataset — data center timelines plus cooling infrastructure (chillers, cooling towers).

body.how_to_read: data_centers is the entity table; timelines tracks build/expansion over time; chillers and cooling_towers are infrastructure detail. Read each CSV header for exact columns. Datacenter-scale demand/power context.

methodology.summary: As-downloaded Epoch AI 'Frontier Data Centers' export, cleaned by the epoch_ai ingest, copied to blobs on 2026-06-12. Confidence 0.8 (curated CC BY 4.0 dataset).
